name: AREX-2

lineage.how_derived: trained on machine-learning and algorithmic-programming tasks with verifiable feedback plus the earlier AREX deep-research data (card)

purpose: Long-horizon agent that improves a solution over several test-time rounds (propose, measure, reflect, revise); for research on iterative problem solving, machine-learning engineering, algorithmic coding and tool-augmented deep research (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file read: Apache License 2.0. The card adds: follow the terms and notices of the Qwen base model and any downstream data or tools.

architecture.kind: dense hybrid linear-attention vision-language model, Qwen3.8-27B layout (config qwen3_5, hidden 5120)
architecture.why_this_design: Unchanged Qwen3.8-27B architecture; the contribution is the long-horizon reflective training (arXiv 2609.38288).

variants.notes: IQ4_XS 15.24, Q6_K 23.62, Q8_0 28.67 GB, mmproj 0.93 GB; 12.6k downloads

pc-12gb.variant: bartowski GGUF Q4_K_M plus mmproj (17.2 + 0.93 GB)
pc-12gb.notes: 18.1 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.variant: bartowski GGUF Q4_K_M plus mmproj (17.2 + 0.93 GB)
pc-16gb.notes: 18.1 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.variant: bartowski GGUF Q4_K_M plus mmproj (17.2 + 0.93 GB)
pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.variant: bartowski GGUF Q4_K_M plus mmproj (17.2 + 0.93 GB)
pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.variant: bartowski GGUF Q4_K_M plus mmproj (17.2 + 0.93 GB)
mac-16-24gb.notes: 18.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.variant: bartowski GGUF Q4_K_M plus mmproj (17.2 + 0.93 GB)
mac-32gb.notes: 18.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.variant: bartowski GGUF Q4_K_M plus mmproj (17.2 + 0.93 GB)
mac-64gb+.notes: 18.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Qwen3.8 dense layout, same as the Qwen3.8-27B record.

benchmarks.name: MLE-Lite Any Medal, mean of 3 seeds

strengths: largest gain over a same-size baseline in the card: algorithmic coding and ML engineering via test-time self-improvement
coding and ML-task training also lifted deep-research scores without new search trajectories (card claim)
weaknesses: vendor-only numbers; comparison tables mix closed and open models and the Frontier-CS protocol is the paper's
no SWE-bench or Terminal-Bench numbers in the card, so not comparable to our other coding records
soft.maturity: BAAI AREX line (Base, Turbo, 2) with day-one community GGUFs

tona_fit.reason: Same footprint as Qwen3.8-27B (Q4_K_M 17.2 GB) with Apache-2.0 text verified, but the benchmarks are not the ones that decide coding-agent fit (no SWE-bench, no Terminal-Bench); the reflective multi-round skill is useful for long autonomous tasks. Compare against Qwen3.8-27B with our own harness before offering.
blockers: no dense Qwen3.8 module in Tona
